partition.definition: The full 86-set is git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M release/1.19.2 to dev/1.19.2 under main Java. The disjoint common and language exclusions leave 35/105. The ever-released unresolved catalog includes two additional changed paths outside that primary 86-set, yielding 88 = 39 + 12 + 35 + 2.
partition.catalog_reconciliation: The catalog's 88 remaining main-Java paths and this partition agree. The catalog owner's 33 non-main paths are separate; this ledger does not subtract or classify them.

computercraft.contract: Optional ComputerCraft registration, player/automation label-operation factoring and optional-mod annotation helper. A runtime-compatible dependency is still required; the 26.1.2 registration witness explicitly remains a no-op.

client_launch_screen.contract: Opt-in JVM-property title-screen launch selection. Default gameplay must not open a screen. Selected launch-screen implementations and property helpers are an unresolved dependency closure.

item_details_jei.contract: JEI hovered-ingredient source lifecycle for generic item-detail inspection; never eagerly load JEI on installations without that optional mod.

item_details.contract: Generic styled item details, not packet-only data. The full document/styling/editor closure is outside this bounded existing-class review.

touch_display.contract: Register the Touch Display renderer without changing the existing Printing Press renderer.

command_palette.contract: Palette key registration and localization. The action ledger records the palette's initially coupled UI dependencies.

client_manager_gui.contract: Register the dedicated Client Manager menu screen only on its witnessed target until synchronization/menu support is validated.

client_overlay_scenes.contract: Declarative HUD scene host registration, independent of old label-gun and network-tool reminders. Scene/action/theme closure needs review before independent combination support.

canvas_text_editor.contract: Canvas editor registration and preferences. D2 uses V3/text_editor_v3; the other eight development witnesses retain DRAW/draw registration. Preserve these implementations, not just the current primary name.

tooltip_mode_override.contract: Semantic expanded-tooltip mode with the physical key as default; action registration/service closure is required for the command-driven override.

single_line_input.contract: Shared single-line edit semantics, local undo and event modifier handling. Uses EditBoxAccessor and the SFMSingleLineInput helper; local undo does not imply persisted document history.

manager_editor_actions.contract: Route the Manager Edit button and shortcut through the exact host-bound action. Pure semantic button/ID contracts do not imply the full keyboard or workspace runtime.

tick_graph_null_safety.contract: Skip absent tick-time samples in peak, plotted-point and newer hover/renderer paths. Separate gameplay-visible fix, not an intrinsic Client Manager or action dependency.

client_program_consent.contract: Approval/denial/dismissal and safe confirmation timing/focus. Enabling this witnessed extension also changes legacy confirmation callers; no isolated compatibility claim.

editor_overlay_push.contract: Open-context preference and V2 constructor/close semantics for a pushed editor. Existing no-preference contexts keep replace behavior.

editor_documents.contract: Typed document snapshots/read-only metadata and synchronous rejected-save results/diagnostics. Read-only metadata alone does not prove every editor enforces it.

editor_async_save.contract: Generation-scoped save completion, host-current checks, close-only-the-submitted-version and detach callbacks. Detaching presentation must not claim cancellation of the underlying write.

editor_document_panels.contract: Editor registration createPanel and host-disposal hooks; panel close is not transient covering/resizing.

editor_virtual_save_shortcut.contract: Use key-event modifier bits for Shift+Enter and keypad Enter rather than an OS key poll; changes synthetic and ordinary event handling.

editor_v1_panel_focus_fix.contract: Do not clear text-widget focus while rendering tooltips for a hosted editor.

editor_v1_responsive_layout.contract: Bound the old fixed V1 text/footer/suggestion geometry for smaller screens and panels.

editor_v1_nested_clipping.contract: Clip V1 multiline text and scrollbar through the nested transformed scissor helper; helper and target widget API adapters are required.

editor_v1_empty_document_focus.contract: An empty document click becomes a focusable insertion target instead of returning false.

editor_v2_cursor_advance.contract: Advance every cursor after text insertion including preceding same-line insertions; retain the existing multiline-input limitation.

command_history.contract: Persisted command history configuration only; do not pull it into every client action or terminal.

terminal_remote.contract: Remote terminal endpoint/executable settings consumed by the terminal service factory.

terminal_vox.contract: Raster terminal endpoint path also reads the shared terminal settings; endpoint configuration does not grant process/network authority.

readonly_item_observation.contract: Read a form reference without mutating blank item data. No main-Java call to the added method was found at the primary witness; treat API inclusion separately from an invented active consumer.

evidence_limits: Named functional units are ownership proposals, not registered flags, enabled presets or accepted independent combinations.

All twenty raw source witnesses were read and hashed for every present path. Exact marker probes and source presence are evidence only; they do not automatically widen feature or optional-mod runtime support.

All primary 105 hunks, the five cross-target-only hunks and alternative added imports/member/API forms were reviewed. Secondary target hunks use the same reviewed member boundaries with explicitly preserved target adapters; this is not a gameplay/runtime proof.
Hunks can mix functional members, helper signatures, adapters and line endings. Member-group anchors—not whole-file or package classification—define ownership.
Source witnesses are comparison/one-time migration evidence, never production renderer lookup inputs.

Shared member consumers are proposed OR-inclusion boundaries and are not generic compilation flags. Where actual typed consumers or aggregator closure remain unresolved, independent combinations must fail closed.
No source, catalog, registered flags, Rust, dependencies or generated projects were changed by this ledger; no builds or runtime tests were run.

integration_gates.requirement: Review SFMClientRegistrations and SFMCommandPaletteActions fields/factories/setup members per functional owner. Restore released startup calls for all-off instead of retaining the development aggregator wholesale.

Map SFMActionButton/ActionElement/Audit, SFMSingleLineEditBox/Input, EditBoxAccessor, SFMScissorStack and typed document/panel helpers to actual consumer OR-inclusion. Align mixin/resource membership with the catalog owner's non-main ledger.

Preserve D2 V3/text_editor_v3 versus the eight-target DRAW/draw implementation, including selector omissions or naming differences actually witnessed. Do not rename historical public editor IDs during consolidation.
Guard typed and asynchronous save members separately; retain host-current/generation and submitted-text checks. Metadata readOnly does not prove a legacy editor supports read-only presentation.

The consent-enabled implementation changes existing confirmation callers too. Preserve the full witnessed safety seam or author/test a narrower split; do not claim independent denial/delay/focus combinations yet.

Keep player/automation label factoring with ComputerCraft and Client Manager overloads with client_manager. Guard LabelGunActions' Client Manager import/overloads rather than forcing them into a ComputerCraft-only build. 26.1.2 has retained no-op registration, not a compatible CC runtime proof.

No primary main-Java caller of getReferenceFromFormReadOnly was found. Keep its explicit API owner, without inventing item-details/ComputerCraft dependencies or silently omitting the witnessed method.

Own the 26.1.2 TickTimeGraphRenderer null fix separately from the behavior-preserving TestBarrelTankContainerMenu constructor helper. The latter is not stale-capability recovery or tunnel cache invalidation.

For every target, all new functional flags off must preserve the release witness and public keys/IDs/behavior. Full development combinations must preserve target-specific implementations; partial combinations must compile or fail closed, never silently fall back to a whole historical source snapshot.

registration.baseline_off: Keep the released client text-editor/action registration and client-setup menu listener. Do not route all-off through the development aggregator.
